company.name: Speak
company.shortDescription: Speak is an AI-powered language learning platform and app that focuses on speaking out loud with an AI tutor.
company.description: Speak is a developer of a mobile language-learning application focused on English learning. The application uses speech recognition technology to support conversational practice in real-world contexts. It enables users to improve spoken English skills and listening comprehension, including exposure to different accents, through structured speaking exercises and interaction-based learning features.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered language learning application that teaches speaking through expert-designed lessons, repeated practice, real-time pronunciation and phrasing feedback, and AI conversations.
productsAndServices.name: Speak Language Learning App

productsAndServices.description: A business language training service that provides AI-powered speaking practice, workplace conversation courses, role plays, pronunciation feedback, and tools for managing employee learning.
productsAndServices.name: Speak for Business
